info.name: Grid Status API Info CSV Exports API
List available bulk export files for a dataset

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: ID of the dataset (for example ercot_spp_day_ahead_hourly).

items.docs: List the per-day CSV export files available on S3 for a dataset. Each entry includes the partition date, object size, and last-modified timestamp.

info.name: Generate a presigned S3 URL for a bulk export file

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: ID of the dataset (for example ercot_spp_day_ahead_hourly).

params.name: export_date
params.description: The partition date of the export file (ISO 8601 date).

items.docs: Generate a presigned S3 URL to download a specific per-day export file.
